description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'LDAPConfigAPI' within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing LDAP configuration settings via REST API calls. It includes methods to retrieve ('getOne') and update ('update') LDAP configuration, along with validation rules, setting configuration attributes, and handling data mappings. The class uses traits for configuration and validation, and adheres to a structured API design with OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: LDAPConfigAPI
classes.description: API class for managing LDAP configuration settings, enabling retrieval and update of LDAP configurations within the OrangeHRM system via REST API endpoints.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT request to update LDAP configuration settings. Validates input data, constructs LDAPSetting object, updates configuration, and saves settings.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve current LDAP configuration settings, returning default if not set.

methods.name: setConfigAttributes
methods.description: Sets main LDAP configuration attributes (such as enable, hostname, port, encryption) on LDAPSetting object based on request parameters.

methods.name: setDataMappingAttributes
methods.description: Assigns data attribute mappings to LDAPSetting object from provided data mapping array.

methods.name: setUserLookupSettings
methods.description: Adds user lookup settings to LDAPSetting object from provided array of user lookup settings.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating LDAP configuration, excluding 'id' parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving LDAP configuration, excluding 'id' parameter.
